limitations: The detector is experimental CLI-only and is not enabled in the app.
The whole-score musical quality result remains draft: 32 independent shared-direction regions (including rehearsal letters, first/second endings and repeat fermata) still lack support.
Eleven whole-neighbor occurrences and 633 neighboring line centers remain using 0.000001-point tolerance; symbol copying does not repair this crop-quality limitation.
A source-template match in the gap above a resolved system is a bounded association rule. Broader scores, alternative navigation glyphs and variable instrumentation still need independent tests.
This report does not certify every note on every newly repaginated page; it carries forward unchanged reviewed crop geometry and audits new direction copies explicitly.
